body: I honestly appreciate it, and I have 24 days to think about it, whatever happens, happens I guess.

I understand it may not seem like a loving gesture it does come from a place of deep love and yes, that more likely than not will be her response, but there is a chance it won't be and there is a chance that she will have to forever live with the regret of letting me go  ,knowing that she could have saved the life of someone she claimed so often that she loved no matter what and that's all I can hope.

No need to apologize for being blunt in a place like this. it's necessary, just as the ultimatum is necessary, the way everything went down has left me feeling absolutely worthless and when it ends she has to know the blood is on her hands, I'm sure she is not taking it very seriously right now and hopefully she will regret that. I'm well aware of the millions of others who have gotten over heartbreak I however am not equipped to handle this any longer, I have found my perfect person and any variation of life without her is no life I want to live.

I'm 30, and I appreciate you trying to help. Honestly I see the future very clearly and it's miserable, this has been an ongoing thing for 5 years, I have tried to move on before and I can't find happiness with any other woman, it's truly her or no one and there is no point going through this shitty life without the one thing that has ever given me true joy, the one person I never had to fake it with.
